name: Boreal Rage Trap

source.title: Pathfinder One-Shot #4: Mark of the Mantis

items.name: Exhale
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters either of the marked areas, or a creature remains in the room for 1 minute

---

Effect The trap breathes cold that envelops a 15-foot burst centered on the triggering creature's square. This deals 4d8+18 cold damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save), and a creature that critically fails the save becomes Clumsy 1 for 10 minutes due to frostbite.

text: A stuffed owlbear twists toward intruders and breathes a gust of frigid air.
